subject: Re: Encord Business Dinner // 05.05.26 // 40ppl // 6:00pm
text:
- Could you tell us a bit more about the occasion you're planning?

A curated, invite-only AI leaders dinner hosted by Encord, a series we run
in cities across the US to bring together Chief AI Officers, Heads of ML,
and senior technical leaders for a candid, off-the-record peer discussion.
No slides, no sales pitch. We've hosted these in Boston, New York, SF, Palo
Alto, and London. Seattle is our next stop, targeting the robotics and
autonomy community, likely Tuesday May 5th for ~20–25 guests.

   - What are the most important factors for you when choosing a venue?

enough space for 30-40 people without feeling crammed, a separate area for
a ~1 hour drinks reception before dinner, and a venue with genuine name
recognition that gives guests a reason to show up. Round tables strongly
preferred over long banquet-style. The venue itself is part of the invite
hook.

   - Are you envisioning a seated dinner, a standing reception, or a
   combination of both?

Both. ~1 hour standing drinks reception first so guests can mingle freely,
then a seated dinner. This format has been the highest-performing across
all our events. The standing reception is where a lot of the best
conversations happen before anyone is locked into a fixed seat.

   - Would your group be open to considering semi-private dining spaces?

Fully private only. Past experiences showed us that a curtain-divided room
kills the intimacy and confidentiality of the conversation. Guests need to
feel they're in a closed, exclusive setting — it's central to the
"off-the-record, candid" atmosphere that makes these dinners work.
